title: what watch?
body:
can i ask what watches people use as collector?

i have a lg watch sport and a sony smartwatch 3 both work but the lg is so chunky and sony watch always on screen is too dark

comments.body: I have a Ticwatch Pro and Ticwatch E in combination with miaomiao Bluetooth transmitter. Flawless combo.
oh nice, how is the always on screen with the pro?

Full day, no issues - that's how I run it. I use my Ticwatch Pro all day because I use nfc for payments, and my Ticwatch E at night while I sleep. They charge superfast so you can re-use the same watch for both if you let it charge during your shower or dinner. It also has a custom root and development on xda here: https://forum.xda-developers.com/smartwatch/other-smartwatches/rom-kernel-t3821013/amp/
Honestly, the Ticwatch Pro is the best Wear OS smartwatch on the market at the moment. I've followed up on and seen them all.
interesting, il give that one a look thanks for your help :)

You're most welcome. Remember, you must use a Bluetooth transmitter like blucon or miaomiao to receive glucose readings to your android watches unless it's the Sony smartwatch 3 - which allows direct nfc scanning. I like cgm, so I got the miaomiao.

with the ticwatch pro, that essentials screen can that show xdrip watchface ? or is it a fixed screen 

didnt mean to hit close sorry heh

Not sure what you mean by essential screen. Ticwatch Pro allows xdrip watchfaces and complications for other watchfaces (meaning if you choose your own watchface, wear OS let's you see your blood glucose in the xdrip complication).
hiya i meant the low power screen the pro has, the one that looks like a retro watch face
@castdoom, no Essential Mode only shows time, date, heart rate, and steps. It's good when using it in half and half mode, but since I have two watches, I use always on display - smartwatch mode only.
Hello, does the Ticwatch Pro need to patched like I had to do with my Huawei Watch2 sport or will xdrip work out of the box ?
Does anybody tried the new Ticwatch C2 - it looks like a smaller Ticwatch Pro without speaker and a little bit less accu (415mAh vs. 400mAh), but everything else (NFC, WLAN, BT) included...
